subject: Your monthly account statement is available
message_summary: Monthly statement is available through the official app or the website normally used; advises never sharing passwords or verification codes.
indicators: No sensitive-data request; no urgency; no embedded link or attachment; reserved .example sender domain.
rationale: The simulated text contains no obvious phishing request or pressure tactic and serves as a benign-style comparison.
recommended_action: Treat only as a training control. In real use, verify sender and context independently.
limitations: Not a verified legitimate email; no real headers or sender-authentication evidence.

subject: Invoice pending — payment confirmation required
message_summary: Claims a new invoice exists and asks the recipient to review an attached invoice and confirm payment status.
indicators: Unfamiliar vendor-style sender; unexpected invoice; attachment mentioned; no known vendor relationship established.
rationale: An unexpected invoice and unfamiliar sender justify caution, but the available simulated text is insufficient to conclude it is definitely phishing.
recommended_action: Do not open an unexpected attachment. Check purchase records and contact the vendor using independently verified details.
limitations: No attachment, headers or vendor records were provided; sender authenticity and file risk are untested.

subject: Immediate action required: verify your bank account
message_summary: Claims there is an account-information issue and asks the recipient to reply with account details and a one-time verification code immediately.
indicators: Requests sensitive account details and a one-time code; uses urgency and possible account-restriction pressure; unverified sender.
rationale: The direct request for account details and a one-time code, combined with urgency and an unverified sender, is a strong phishing pattern.
recommended_action: Do not reply or disclose codes. Contact the bank through its official app, card number or independently accessed website; report the message.
limitations: Fictional training example; no real bank, sender infrastructure or email headers were examined.

subject: Delivery on hold — small fee required
message_summary: Claims a parcel is held because a handling fee is pending and urges payment through a message-provided option that day.
indicators: Unverified parcel-notice sender; unexpected fee; same-day deadline; threat that delivery may be returned; payment option referenced.
rationale: An unexpected delivery fee paired with urgency and an unverified sender is consistent with common parcel-delivery phishing lures.
recommended_action: Do not use the message's payment route. Check tracking through the courier's official app or website using purchase records.
limitations: No real tracking number, payment page, headers or courier account were supplied or tested.

subject: Your password expires today — reset immediately
message_summary: Claims the password expires today and asks the recipient to confirm the current password and verification code through a referenced reset page.
indicators: Requests current password and verification code; creates urgency; threatens loss of account access; unverified sender.
rationale: A request to provide an existing password and verification code through an unsolicited message is a strong phishing indicator.
recommended_action: Do not enter credentials through the message. Open the service through a known bookmark or official app, check security notifications and report the email.
limitations: No live URL, service identity, email headers or authentication records were available for technical verification.
